title: OpenPermit ORI project target: 24-hour review for single-family homes (non-binding design target)

scope.applies_to: Review of a complete single-family residential (IRC single-family scope) building-permit submission.
scope.clock_start: complete_submission_event: the recorded event at which the submission is determined complete by the reviewing authority
scope.clock_stop: review_decision_event: the recorded review decision (approve, approve with conditions, or return with corrections)
scope.tolling: Intervals bounded by recorded pause/toll events (each carrying its authority) are excluded from active hours; elapsed hours are reported alongside, unadjusted.
scope.jurisdiction: none — this target is not tied to, adopted by, or claimed for any jurisdiction

legal_boundary.rule: This is the OpenPermit ORI project's own design target: a performance level ORI is built to enable and measure. It is not a law, not HUD or other government guidance, and not any jurisdiction's rule. It is not a claim that any jurisdiction meets it or must meet it, and no evidence that it is achievable is asserted here. Measurements against it are comparison output, never compliance findings.

controls.practice: ORI project design target (self-declared, non-binding): review of a complete single-family residential submission reaches a review decision within 24 hours, measured from the complete-submission event to the review-decision event using recorded start, completion, and pause/toll events.
